protocol.question: Does the failed AGA-plus-B-reset protection follow the transformed O change, the attention inputs, or the receiving residual and readout context?
protocol.design: Keep the prior 400 odd synthetic views and both releases fixed. Recover the parent with the author AGA once, and verify its final O against the last-layer kernel. Replacing B erases all other candidate edits. Apply pre-alignment and post-alignment O differences separately to the captured attention output of direct TA and AGA-then-TA. Also add the actual direct per-view residual difference to the aligned residual. Recompute LN2, public MLP and final classifier in each context.
protocol.checks: The parent and actual edited rows reproduce the earlier direct and AGA B-reset logits and decisions. Report all crossed conditions, teacher agreements, score margins and norms in the fixed class-readout span.
protocol.scope: Post-hoc counterfactuals on the archived synthetic views. One full parent AGA replay, two last-layer checks, and 800 frozen synthetic image forwards. No fits, weight publications, natural evaluation, or attack benchmarks.
